note: Structured layer the v2 assembler needs on top of meiji-resolutions.json, where the research states a fact in prose: (1) for each resolved village transfer, the 1920 町村 whose prefecture the moved land shared BEFORE the move (`fromRef`: a 町村 that was always in the 郡 the land came from) — so the land's side on every earlier interval is read from that 町村, not from a single from_pref; (2) date windows where the research gives only a year/month; (3) corrections that change the membership table; (4) which `unresolved` entries of meiji-prefectures.json the research settles. Every entry names the resolution / correction it transcribes. Jurisdiction is dated by the legal order (main-session decision 2026-10-05); custody / hand-over dates are notes only.
